rig.name: Jim Croce - Time In A Bottle - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and maintain signal clarity for delicate fingerpicking.
blocks.gap: None. Standard practice for clean recordings.

blocks.purpose: Gentle compression to even out the dynamics of fingerpicked arpeggios, adding warmth and sustain.
blocks.gap: The ideal module would be a dedicated acoustic preamp/DI box. Comp is used for dynamic control.

blocks.purpose: Bypass. No distortion or overdrive is required for a dry folk sound.
Provides a clean, warm, and non-aggressive tone suitable for acoustic simulations without the harshness of electric amps.
blocks.gap: The US Deluxe is an electric amp model. However, its inherent cleanliness and vintage character make it the best choice to simulate a high-quality DI/acoustic preamp sound.

blocks.purpose: Simulates a small, intimate recording environment suitable for close-mic studio capture.
blocks.gap: While not an acoustic cabinet, the US 2x12 provides a focused, non-boomy sound that complements the clean tone and simulates proximity recording.

blocks.purpose: Subtly boosts the fundamental frequencies (bass/mids) to enhance the 'woody body resonance' and clarity of arpeggios.
blocks.gap: None. Standard tone shaping for folk ballads.

blocks.purpose: Bypass. No filtering or wah effect is needed.
Bypass. Modulation effects (Chorus/Tremolo) are explicitly avoided.
Used minimally to add subtle depth and space without sounding like a rhythmic effect.
blocks.gap: A dedicated acoustic delay would be better, but Digital Delay is used sparingly for ambience only.

blocks.purpose: Provides the required 'minimal room ambience' and studio intimacy without sounding artificial or overly wet.
blocks.gap: None. Room reverb is ideal for dry, natural acoustic recordings.

improvements.summary: Replace the generic US 2x12 IR with a dedicated acoustic or DI cabinet simulation to better match the dry, intimate studio sound.

proposals.recommendedAsset: Acoustic/DI Cabinet IR (e.g., Neve 1073 modeled cab)
proposals.reason: The US 2x12 is an electric cabinet; a DI or acoustic cab will sound more authentic for studio folk.
proposals.expectedGain: Improved realism and woody tone focus
